name: webmcp-extension
description: Chrome extension and companion server for inspecting, monitoring, and executing WebMCP tools exposed by web pages.

scripts.test: rm -rf dist/tests && esbuild tests/extension/*.test.ts tests/server/*.test.ts tests/smoke/*.smoke.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --packages=external --format=esm --jsx=automatic --outbase=tests --outdir=dist/tests && node --test dist/tests/extension/*.test.js dist/tests/server/*.test.js dist/tests/smoke/*.smoke.test.js; status=$?; rm -rf dist/tests; exit $status
scripts.test:unit: rm -rf dist/tests && esbuild tests/extension/*.test.ts tests/server/*.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --packages=external --format=esm --jsx=automatic --outbase=tests --outdir=dist/tests && node --test dist/tests/extension/*.test.js dist/tests/server/*.test.js; status=$?; rm -rf dist/tests; exit $status
scripts.test:smoke: rm -rf dist/tests && esbuild tests/smoke/*.smoke.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --packages=external --format=esm --jsx=automatic --outbase=tests --outdir=dist/tests && node --test dist/tests/smoke/*.smoke.test.js; status=$?; rm -rf dist/tests; exit $status
scripts.screenshots: esbuild tests/smoke/screenshots.ts --bundle --platform=node --packages=external --format=esm --outfile=dist/screenshots.js --log-level=warning && node dist/screenshots.js; status=$?; rm -f dist/screenshots.js; exit $status
